page_size._note: No bleed per Jerry's rule — white substrate, no digital print to edge.

substrate.color_origin: Substrate is white (clear acrylic with white backing/lamination); no /Face-Cut separation required.

face_paint.name: White
face_paint._note: Per Jerry's 90253 reference pattern, white-substrate signs omit the /Face-Cut separation entirely.

copy_paint.name: Reflex Blue C
copy_paint.alt_rgb_note: Jerry's 90253 reference uses RGB ICCBased altspace, not CMYK. Match for byte-identical altspace if needed; CMYK fallback is the WebEsko-spec default.

unit_conversion.rule: All EPS-source numeric values (font_size, positions) are in EPS userspace units. Convert to PDF points via formula below.

esko_spot_colors_omitted.Face-Cut: White acrylic substrate per Jerry 90253 reference — no face paint separation needed.

reference.modeled_after: Jerry's 90253 reference (Intown Stairwell) — same white-acrylic + Reflex Blue pattern.

fields._note: Rendered as live text in base PDF (NOT overlaid by renderer). IG's responsibility — never changes per order.
Single-digit floor number (1, 2, 3, 4, etc.). Overlays in /Text spot.

overlay_spot_color.rule: Renderer MUST overlay this text in the /Text named spot color from the base PDF's ColorSpace dict. Do NOT use /White or any other spot.

fields._note: Renderer translates 'LEVEL [n]' to Grade 2 braille at overlay time. Whole-string translation (not just digit), because 'LEVEL' contractions matter in Grade 2.

overlay_spot_color.rule: Renderer MUST overlay translated braille glyphs in the /Braille named spot color from the base PDF. Do NOT use /White or any other spot.

braille_translation.rule: Renderer translates the full source_text ('LEVEL 4') to Grade 2 ASCII Braille. 'LEVEL' is a word — Grade 2 contractions may apply. Number indicator + dropped letter for the digit.
braille_translation._note: Grade 2 may contract 'level' to a shorter braille form per BANA rules; renderer's Grade 2 library handles this.

do_not_use.rendering_literal_digits_as_braille_font: Writing '(LEVEL 4)' literally through California Braille font does NOT produce valid Grade 2 braille.
do_not_use.unicode_braille_codepoints: California Braille is a SHAPE FONT keyed off ASCII characters.

combination_explanation: Static prefix 'LEVEL ' baked into PDF at SKU build. Variable floor number + braille overlay per order.
